title: Priming proof: collect priming_proof_test.py in CI and produce the first before/after agreement number
description:
docs/priming-proof.md specifies the number (agreement with editors on a frozen held-out set at N=0 and after N priming labels) and src/papyrus_content/priming_proof.py:187-262 implements run_priming_proof with the freeze-priming-held-out and prove-priming commands, but no number exists yet. src/papyrus_content/priming_proof_test.py contains a deterministic stub (NearestTrainingExampleModel at :19) and is one of five src/*_test.py files that nothing collects (pyproject.toml:65 testpaths excludes src). The hosted S3 priming-catalog adapter is documented as 'not built, fails closed'.

Fix: move or collect priming_proof_test.py (and the other four src/*_test.py files) so pytest runs them in CI; build the minimum catalog adapter needed to read accepted priming examples; then, on Ryan's Mac by Remote Control (the run needs the decision-model provider key, never a cloud agent), run freeze-priming-held-out --size 40 and prove-priming with --schedule 0,5,10,20,40 for the Threat Intelligence publication, and commit the report JSON where docs/priming-proof.md says visitors see it.

Done when: the test runs green in CI and a published report shows agreement at N=0 and at the largest N.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
